correctness.rationale: The program constructs all 30 vertices and 45 incidences from definitions, proves girth 8 by exhaustive shortest alternate-edge routes, and enumerates the same 90 octagons by graph DFS and by independent four-duad/syntheme quadrangles. Every edge occurs 16 times, yielding the exact modulo-four nonzero theorem. Tree-switching exhausts all 65,536 dual classes; direct signed sums agree with an integer Walsh transform at each class. The complete histogram, Parseval, exact sum identities, full 16-dimensional cycle span and explicit value -2 at cotree mask 85 all pass. No finite data are extrapolated to an infinite claim.

originality.rationale: The inspected 2015 AMS and Baez accounts give the graph, octagon count and quadrangle interpretation, but not the signed spectrum. The complete 2016 arXiv HTML article characterizes generalized Tutte–Coxeter graph symmetry via cycle-type counts; its results do not encode the signed 65,536-class character distribution. The MathWorld spectrum is 30-vertex adjacency, a different operator. Searches of published mathematical records found a majority-dynamics classification and a topological octagon-pair result, not a theorem dominating the present Boolean convolution spectrum. A prior unindexed equivalent remains possible.
residual_risks: An older unindexed signed-shortest-cycle spectrum, coding-theoretic enumerator, or ancillary table may be equivalent.
Full published pages for two topically related records were unavailable; their summaries were not treated as whole-document originality evidence.
The claim is deliberately confined to this finite graph; no general cage theorem is claimed.

value.rationale: The unique cubic 8-cage is a canonical generalized-quadrangle incidence graph and its shortest cycles are a natural binary sensing codebook. Beyond the known unsigned count 90, the full eighteen signed levels and their multiplicities specify exactly the information and stability of a huge-dimensional convolution that reduces to sixteen gauge parameters. The zero-free congruence despite an even codebook and sharp inverse norm are meaningful structural invariants of this natural object, not a selected arbitrary subset or a modest numeric improvement.
